landingPage.heroDescription: A minimal open-source Astro blog with long posts, short notes, tags, search and RSS feeds, deployed on Hostinger at a reviewed version.
landingPage.about: Astro Cactus is a minimal open-source blog theme built with Astro and Tailwind CSS by its original author. It suits writers and developers who want a quiet, fast personal site where the words come first. You publish long-form posts and short notes in Markdown, readers browse by tag or search the whole site, and RSS feeds keep subscribers up to date. Every post gets a generated social image, so links look good when they are shared. There is no database or admin panel to look after: the site builds to static pages from your Markdown files. Hostinger deploys the original project at a version we have checked, with its MIT license.

features.title: Posts and notes
features.description: Publish long-form posts and short notes as separate, paginated collections.

features.title: Site search
features.description: A search index is built with the site, so readers can search every post without a server.

features.title: Tags and RSS
features.description: Every post is tagged and listed, with RSS feeds for posts and for notes.

features.title: Social images
features.description: Each post gets its own generated preview image for social networks and chat apps.

features.title: Light and dark themes
features.description: A clean monospace design with a light and dark theme switch.

features.title: Markdown first
features.description: Write in Markdown or MDX and keep the whole blog in plain text files.

landingPage.metaDescription: Start a fast, minimal personal blog with Astro Cactus: posts, short notes, tags, site search and RSS feeds, built from Markdown files. Deploy it on Hostinger.
landingPage.short: Minimal Astro blog with posts, notes, tags, search and RSS.
landingPage.long: Astro Cactus is a minimal open-source Astro blog for writers and developers, with long posts, short notes, tag archives, built-in search, RSS feeds and generated social images.
